aslan_life_events.name: Aslan Life Events
aslan_life_events.note: Outcast Aslan use the standard Core Rulebook Life Events table instead.

results.2: Sickness or Injury: You are injured or become sick. Roll on the Injury table.
results.3: Birth or Death: Someone close to you dies, like a friend or pride member. Alternatively, someone close to you gives birth (or is born!). You are involved in some fashion (father or mother, pridekin, honour guard).
results.4: Territory Challenge: A rival attempts to claim some of your Territory (or your sire's or mate's Territory, if you have none of your own). Make a Diplomat, Broker, Melee (Natural) or Gun Combat check and increase or decrease your TER (or SOC, if you have no Territory) by the Effect of the roll.
results.5: Change in Marriage Status: If not married, you are now married (either to an existing Ally or Contact, another Traveller, or a mate arranged by your clan). If already married, roll 1D: on 1–4, another female is added to the pride. On a 5–6, your mate is slain.
results.6: Clan Event: Roll on the Clan Event table.
results.7: New Contact: You gain a new Contact.
results.8: Clan Event: Roll on the Clan Event table.
results.9: Travel: You move to another world. Gain DM+2 to your next qualification roll.
results.10: Duel: You are challenged to a duel over a matter of family honour. If you refuse, lose SOC −1. If you accept, roll Melee (Natural) 8+. If you succeed, gain SOC +1; otherwise, lose SOC −2.
results.11: Dishonoured: You are accused of a crime. Roll Advocate 8+ or Melee (Natural) 10+ to defend yourself (if you have any Contacts or Allies in the clan, you gain DM+2 to the Advocate roll). If you cannot defend yourself, you drop to SOC 2 and become Outcast.
results.12: Unusual Event: Something weird. Roll 1D: 1=Psionic encounter (human psionic institute, Zhodani agent or telepathic plant). 2=Aliens: You travel extensively with non-Aslan; gain Tolerance. 3=Alien Artefact: You come into possession of a curious piece of alien technology or an archaeological relic. 4=Amnesia: There is a gap in your memory. 5=Contact with Clan Leaders: The elders of your clan entrust you with a mission or a secret. 6=Ancient Technology: You have an item that is older than the Aslan race.

results.1: Prosperous Times: The clan acquires new Territories or trade routes. Gain an extra Benefit roll or DM+2 to your next advancement roll.
results.2: Rising Fortunes: Your clan's political standing improves. Gain SOC +1.
results.3: New Ally: A member of your clan rises to an influential position. Gain him or her as an Ally.
results.4: Feud: Your family is now feuding with another Aslan family. Gain the enemy family as an Enemy.
results.5: War: Your clan goes to war. If male, you suffer DM-2 to survival rolls next term. If female, lose one Benefit roll.
results.6: Hard Times: Your clan suffers economic hardship. You suffer DM-4 to advancement rolls this term, and gain no Benefit rolls for it.
